description: Na₈TiAs₄ crystallizes in the cubic Fd̅3m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ti and six equivalent As atoms. Both Na-Ti bond lengths are 2.97 Å. All Na-As bond lengths are 3.18 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent As atoms. There are two shorter (3.00 Å) and two longer (3.14 Å) Na-As bond lengths. Ti is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to four equivalent Na and four equivalent As atoms. All Ti-As bond lengths are 2.50 Å. As is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to nine Na and one Ti atom.
